investigation.root_cause: The injected rag_slow incident adds a blocking 2.5-second sleep inside retrieval. Under concurrency this synchronous work also serializes requests on the event loop.

fix_action: Disable the incident and remove the artificial blocking delay; production retrieval should use non-blocking I/O with a bounded timeout.
preventive_measure: Keep the rag_retrieve child span, alert on tail latency, add timeout/fallback behavior, and run a concurrent latency regression test before release.
